column1: # AUDIT03. The runner used to DISCOVER tests with the glob `*Tests.m`, which
# silently excluded 23 of 78 files. Renaming them was ruled out on evidence:
# TSK-ALGO-004 and TSK-MIXED-001 are cited by name in BOTH manuscripts.
# Widening the glob was ruled out too: 11 of the 23 export a literal "OK"
# and cannot fail, so collecting them would have added 11 fake greens.
# So membership is DECLARED, not inferred. A new .m file is neither included
# nor excluded until someone classifies it, and tools/check_test_manifest.sh
# goes red until they do -- which is what makes the 'never ran' class
#   test        collected and scored by run-tests.sh
#   quarantine  excluded: the status does not depend on any computation
#   producer    excluded: writes artefacts, exports no status
